regionSummary: Illinois has strong nuclear siting fundamentals: existing nuclear campuses, high-voltage grid, large cooling reservoirs/rivers and a pro-nuclear policy context. U.S. sites still require NRC site review under 10 CFR Part 100 [us-nrc-10cfr100], non-seismic population/exclusion-area analysis [us-nrc-100-21], NEPA review [us-nepa], and cooling-water intake review where applicable [us-cwa-316b].
